Top 50 Databricks Terms You Need to Know for Data Engineering! 🚀
Databricks is a cloud-based platform that unifies data engineering, machine learning, and analytics, empowering teams to work collaboratively and efficiently. Built on Apache Spark, Databricks provides tools to manage and analyze massive datasets with ease. With features like Delta Lake for data lake management, real-time processing, and seamless cloud integration, it has become a go-to platform for modern data engineers. Whether you're optimizing Spark workloads or diving into machine learning, mastering Databricks is key to advancing your data skills!" 📈💡
